descriptions.inProgress: According to #p1002104#, one of the clocktowers in #m220000000# has broken down. This clocktower manages time, and when it broke, it somehow created a path to the past. Exploring the past could reveal some information about Seal Stones. #bThe busted clocktower with the time-control room can be accessed through the ladder on the top floor of Helios Tower#k, so you should make you way over there.
